temporal-rate-326f6e6f.title: Temporal Rate
temporal-rate-326f6e6f.interpretation: Temporal Rate: The rate at which a particle orbits magnetic field lines, independent of its speed.

simplicity-rule-3e56d70d.title: Simplicity rule

pmns-mixing-matrix-f55da4b8.title: PMNS Mixing Matrix
pmns-mixing-matrix-f55da4b8.interpretation: The transformation relating flavor eigenstates to mass eigenstates via the Pontecorvo-Maki-Nakagawa-Sakata matrix.

energy-momentum-recoil-balance-24e0aa53.title: Energy-Momentum Recoil Condition
energy-momentum-recoil-balance-24e0aa53.interpretation: Ensures that the discrete exchange of energy and momentum is balanced by the recoil of the nucleus or lattice.
energy-momentum-recoil-balance-24e0aa53.symmetry_origin: The global conservation of the four-momentum vector in a bound system.
energy-momentum-recoil-balance-24e0aa53.limits_and_boundary: Physically prohibits the absorption of a photon by a strictly isolated, free electron, necessitating the presence of a third body.
